        "contents": "const AddTextModal: React.FC&lt;AddTextModalProps&gt; = \nconst [selectedSearchResults, setSelectedSearchResults] = &lt;Set&lt;number&gt;&gt;(new Set());\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    \n    if (mode === \"text\") {\n      if (!text.trim()) {\n        alert(\"请输入文字内容\");\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // 创建来源，使用文本的前50个字符作为标题\n      const title = text.trim().slice(0, 50) + (text.trim().length &gt; 50 ? \"...\" : \"\");\n      onAddTextSource({\n        title,\n        type: \"external\",\n        description: text.trim(),\n      });\n      \n      setText(\"\");\n      onClose();\n    } else if (mode === \"upload\") {\n      if (files.length === 0) {\n        alert(\"请选择文件\");\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // 上传文件到服务器\n      setIsUploading(true);\n      try {\n        const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(files, pageType);\n        \n        // 将每个上传的文件转换为Source并添加到来源列表\n        uploadedFiles.forEach((uploadedFile) =&gt; {\n          // description字段包含完整的markdown内容，用于传递给Agent\n          // 如果没有markdown内容，则使用文件大小作为描述\n          const description = uploadedFile.markdownContent \n            ? uploadedFile.markdownContent\n            : &#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(uploadedFile.size)}&#96;;\n          \n          onAddTextSource({\n            title: uploadedFile.name,\n            type: \"external\",\n            url: uploadedFile.url,\n            description: description,\n          });\n        });\n        \n        setFiles([]);\n        onClose();\n        // 触发文件列表刷新\n        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('filesUploaded'));\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\n        alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\n      } finally {\n        setIsUploading(false);\n      }\n    } else if (mode === \"search\") {\n      if (!searchQuery.trim()) {\n        alert(\"请输入检索信息\");\n        return;\n      }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    if (params.files &amp;&amp; params.files.length &gt; 0) {\n      try {\n        // 通过文件名查找文件记录，获取markdown内容\n        for (const file of params.files) {\n          try {\n            // 通过原始文件名查找文件记录\n            const allFiles = await fileService.getAllFiles({\n              status: 'active',\n            });\n            const fileRecord = allFiles.find(\n              (f) =&gt; f.original_name === file.originalname || f.stored_name === file.filename\n            );\n            \n            if (fileRecord &amp;&amp; fileRecord.metadata) {\n              const metadata = typeof fileRecord.metadata === 'string' \n                ? JSON.parse(fileRecord.metadata) \n                : fileRecord.metadata;\n              \n              if (metadata.markdownContent) {\n                fileMarkdownContents.push(&#96;【${fileRecord.original_name}】\\n${metadata.markdownContent}&#96;);\n                logger.info('从文件记录中提取markdown内容', {\n                  fileName: fileRecord.original_name,\n                  markdownLength: metadata.markdownContent.length,\n                });\n              }\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            logger.warn('提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n              fileName: file.originalname,\n              error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('批量提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 判断是否是第一次对话（对话不存在或没有历史消息）\n    const isFirstMessage = !params.conversation || \n                          !params.conversation.messages || \n                          params.conversation.messages.length === 0;\n    \n    // 提取附加信息：外部来源的文本内容和文件的markdown内容\n    let additionalContext = '';\n    \n    const textContents: string[] = [];\n  }\n}",
